claim_text_imported_from_judge: On the Gaussian model, MDS outperforms NPE, NNPE, and NPE-OR baselines across a range of contamination proportions, with degradation only appearing at contamination levels above 40% (Figure 2).
paper_statement: In general, our MDS improves robustness compared to other benchmark methods, although for severe proportion of contamination, MDS can degrade.

scope.primary_metric: biased five-bandwidth MMD to the analytic clean posterior

preregistered_decision_rule.verified: Not available for the stronger imported gloss because Figure 2 itself shows NPE-OR below MDS at some contamination levels.
preregistered_decision_rule.falsified: The independent integrity checker passes; frozen NPE hashes agree before/after adaptation; paired 95% bootstrap intervals show MDS below both NPE and NNPE at eps=0.1,0.2,0.3; at least one prespecified eps in {0.1,0.2,0.3} has the NPE-OR-minus-MDS interval wholly below zero; and MDS mean MMD at eps=0.5 exceeds 1.5 times its mean at eps=0.3.
preregistered_decision_rule.blocked: Any integrity, fidelity, comparator, or degradation condition is unresolved.

interpretation_boundary: A FALSIFIED verdict applies only to the stronger imported all-comparator gloss. It does not falsify the paper's explicitly qualified 'in general' statement.
negative_control: Disabling MDS adaptation makes it identical to NPE and must exit nonzero because it cannot establish the intended comparator contradiction.
